rules.statement: An order dismissing an application for probate of a last will is a final judgment if it deals with the question of proof of the last will and the entitlement to have the probate granted.
rules.supporting_quote: The order has the effect of a final judgment in as much as it deals with the question of proof of last will and the entitlement of the intervenient petitioner to have the probate granted.

meta.parties: Mangauka v. Sugandi Fernando And Others
